name: Rechenzentrum TU Clausthal
notes: University computing center in Clausthal-Zellerfeld, Goslar district; source identifies it as the central IT service provider supporting research, teaching and administration with IT infrastructure, cloud, network and security services.

name: PingBASE Rechenzentren Goslar
notes: Small local provider; public contact page lists 'PingBASE Rechenzentren' at Osterwiecker Str. 46A, 38690 Goslar. Limited public technical detail found.

name: TKRZ Nordhorn data center
notes: TKRZ states it offers storage/server services in its data centers in Emsdetten, Greven, Rheine and Nordhorn; colocation page references a Watergreen certificate for the Nordhorn site.

name: Göttingen Data Center / GWDG joint data center
developer: University of Göttingen / GWDG / UMG / Max Planck Society
notes: New joint data center for the Göttingen science location on the North Campus; handed over to GWDG and partners on June 30, 2021 for research, teaching, patient care and administration workloads.

name: Avacon Data Center Sehnde / Datacenter Hannover
developer: Avacon Connect GmbH / envia TEL GmbH / Avacon Data Center GmbH
notes: High-performance colocation data center in Sehnde, Region Hannover. Official envia TEL page says the Avacon/enviaM facility was commissioned in February 2026; earlier Avacon release says 2,000 sqm and space for about 28,000 servers.

name: Telis Lower Saxony Campus / Mehrum data center campus
notes: Proposed 500 MW campus north of Mehrum near Hanover/Peine, with six buildings on about 380,000 sqm. DCD reports construction targeted for 2028 but full municipal approval was still pending.

name: kyberio Hannover data centers
notes: Operator states it runs two autonomous data centers in Hannover at Am Eisenwerk and Am Mittelfelde, plus a Frankfurt PoP; public specifications include 28,000 sq ft technical footprint, redundant infrastructure and ISO 27001 based on BSI IT-Grundschutz.

name: nLighten Hanover HAJ1
notes: nLighten public location page describes the Hanover edge data center near the A2 and Hanover Airport with more than 863 sqm area and 1,800 kW of power; Baxtel also lists it as the largest Lower Saxony facility by known power.

name: Rechenzentrum Seevetal / Maschen project
developer: REVITALIS Vierunddreissigste Grundstücksgesellschaft mbH / Revitalis Development GmbH
notes: Project website says the Seevetal site concept is being revised after discussions with the municipality, agencies and public feedback; local reporting describes Revitalis plans for a data center in Maschen/Seevetal, with secondary real-estate reporting citing about 60 MW.

name: Büddenstedt West data centers
developer: Undisclosed project developers / City of Helmstedt planning process
notes: City of Helmstedt council document for Bebauungsplan/Sondergebiet Rechenzentrum Büddenstedt West states three developers proposed wind/PV and two data centers on the site; final-stage total facility power cited as about 170 MW, with zoning/land-use changes required.
